units.source_text: 我说的雪落在梅花上和美丽的婴儿在吃草莓，正确的说法应该是：雪降梅花上，漂亮乳儿吃草莓。

en.t: What I said was, "snow falls on the plum blossoms, and a beautiful baby is eating strawberries," but the correct wording should have been: "snow descends on the plum blossoms, and a pretty infant eats strawberries."

units.source_text: 可是，当时校长却十分惊讶，母亲也引以自豪，我至今记忆犹新。

en.t: But at the time the principal was very surprised, my mother was proud of it, and I still remember it vividly even now.
